نبتل (form VIII)
# نَبْتَلِ (nabtali) /nab.ta.li/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# نُبْتَلَ (nubtala) /nub.ta.la/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
